name: @mooter/turboquant-backend
description: Mooter TurboQuant backend (Wave 33) — OPT-IN 3-bit KV-cache quantization (3.6-5.2× memory reduction, model-dependent) via a build-from-source wrapper around the AmesianX/TurboQuant llama.cpp fork. Mainline llama.cpp rejected the PR, so source build is the only path; CUDA 12.8 + CMake required. Detects prereqs and refuses gracefully (stays on stock llama.cpp/Ollama). EXPERIMENTAL. Pure TS, all I/O injectable.
